title: PostureFinding
description: The result of evaluating a Control against an Asset. Base: OCSF Compliance Finding (class_uid 2003). Extended with lifecycle status, temporal posture tracking, compound risk membership, and sensitivity context.

finding_id.description: Stable SHA-256 of (control_id, asset_id). Same (control, asset) pair always produces the same ID across assessments. Enables cross-run correlation, dwell tracking, and idempotent ticket import. Hash inputs: 'finding:' + control_id + ':' + asset_id, truncated to 16 hex chars. Does not include predicate version or observed values — stable across schema evolution.

verdict.description: The CEL predicate's evaluation outcome against the observed asset state. VIOLATION: predicate returned false. PASS: predicate returned true. INCOMPLETE: evaluation could not produce a binary determination.

incomplete_reason.description: Required when verdict is INCOMPLETE. Why the evaluation did not produce PASS or VIOLATION. MISSING_PROPERTY: a required field was absent from the snapshot. PREDICATE_ERROR: CEL compilation or runtime error. STALE_OBSERVATION: no snapshot newer than the configured freshness threshold.

incomplete_detail.description: Optional human-readable detail for INCOMPLETE verdicts. E.g., the missing field path, the CEL error message, or the staleness gap.

status.description: Lifecycle state independent of verdict. ACTIVE: finding requires action. SUPPRESSED: finding covered by an active Exemption. RESOLVED: finding no longer detected (control now passes). Maps to ocsf:status_id.

first_seen.description: When this finding was first detected. Immutable once set. Persists across status transitions including SUPPRESSED periods.

dwell_days.description: Days since first_seen. Continues to accumulate during SUPPRESSED periods because the underlying violation persists.

suppression.description: Present only when status is SUPPRESSED. References the Exemption that covers this finding.

suppression_history.description: Past suppression periods. Populated when an exemption expires or is revoked and the finding transitions SUPPRESSED → ACTIVE. Preserves the audit trail.

chain_findings.description: IDs of CompoundRisk patterns this finding participates in.

evidence.description: Properties from the snapshot that caused the violation.

reasoning.description: Deterministic evaluation context. Contains everything needed to reproduce the verdict given the predicate source and observation. Required on every PostureFinding regardless of verdict.

predicate_id.description: Stable identifier for the CEL predicate version that produced this finding. Enables correlation across catalog updates.

dependencies.description: Property paths the predicate reads, extracted statically from the control definition. Sorted lexicographically.

observed_values.description: Map from property path to the value actually observed at evaluation time. Keys are a subset of dependencies — only paths that resolved. Missing paths are recorded in missing_paths instead.

missing_paths.description: Dependency paths that did not resolve against the observation. Sorted. Structural cause of INCOMPLETE verdicts.

evaluation_ms.description: Wall-clock evaluation time in milliseconds for performance debugging.

triggers.description: Optional. Populated only in multi-snapshot contexts (snapshotdiff, forensics, drift). Attributes the finding to specific property changes between snapshots.

prior_snapshot_id.description: Snapshot compared against. Null if first in series.

changed_paths.description: Subset of reasoning.dependencies where the value differs between prior and current snapshot. Sorted.

prior_values.description: Map from changed path to the value in the prior snapshot. Keys match changed_paths exactly.

prior_verdict.description: Verdict in the prior snapshot. Null if the finding did not exist.

verdict_delta.description: How the verdict changed between snapshots. Derivable from verdict + prior_verdict but emitted explicitly.

anomaly.description: Present only when verdict flipped but no dependency path changed. Signals a catalog update or non-determinism bug.
